profile.name: Mahdi Shabani
profile.tagline: Researching explainable, uncertainty-aware machine learning for spatial decision-making — from mineral prospectivity mapping to computer-vision classification.

projects.title: AIM Core Log — AI-Powered Drill Core Classification
projects.description: An AI-powered computer vision tool that automates lithology classification from drill core photographs for mineral exploration. Built on a PyTorch training pipeline with transfer learning, an active-learning feedback loop for continuous model improvement from geologist corrections, and a web-based review interface designed around industry-standard core logging conventions. Currently training on a custom proprietary dataset.

projects.title: KanYab — AI-Powered Geochemical Exploration Analytics
projects.description: KanYab helps mineral exploration teams find what matters in their geochemical data — automatically flagging anomalous samples and identifying the pathfinder elements that signal ore-grade mineralization, so geologists can prioritize drill targets with statistical confidence instead of manual spreadsheet review.

research.title: Development of an Explainable and Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning Framework for Spatial Decision-Making
research.description: This report presents a novel framework that integrates explainable AI and uncertainty quantification to enhance spatial decision-making processes. By improving transparency and reliability, the framework aims to support stakeholders in making informed decisions based on complex spatial data.

timeline.title: Master / Industrial Engineering with a focus on Modeling and Data Analysis
